name: Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer
summary: A solvent-based sealer that helps protect against stains, soiling, discolouration and efflorescence
metaDescription: A solvent-based sealer that helps protect against stains, soiling, discolouration and efflorescence
attributes: Clear solution which cures to an invisible, water repellent coating
usage: Suitable for interior and exterior applications.
Commercial and domestic walls and floor grout joints.
Can also be used over most unglazed porous ceramic tiles.
advantages: Clear solution which cures to an invisible, water repellent coating

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry cool conditions off ground out of direct sunlight

items.label: Application Time
items.text: Allow Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer to dry for 24 hours prior to returning to service

items.label: Consumption
items.text: Approximately 6-10m2/L (depending upon surface porosity and site conditions)

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Ensure grout joints and tile surfaces are thoroughly dry, clean, free from dirt, dust, grease, oil, wax and other contaminants.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Apply using a sponge, brush or spray gun.
Allow 5-10 minutes for the sealer to penetrate the surface, then wipe off excess with a damp sponge.
Allow the sealer to cure for 24 hours prior to returning the area to service.
Note: If only sealing grout joints of porous ceramic or terracotta tiles, ensure clean up method is pre-tested. It may be necessary to mask the joints

items.label: CLEANING OF TOOLS
items.text: Excess Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer and tools can be cleaned up with Mineral Turpentine while the product is still wet / prior to drying.
